
		<h2>
			<a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/GKLBB/p/19165738" title="发布于 2025-10-25 18:41">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">应用安全 --- win安全 之 VMP初体验</span>
    

</a>

		</h2>
		<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>VMP是一种软件加固方法</p>
<p>Virtual Machine Protect. 虚拟机保护 ，可以将汇编指令转化为自定义指令集，虚拟指令涉及上百万条汇编指令，极大增强pj难度。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>由win版本的和linux，安卓版本的。他们的软件实现方法和厂家都不一样，但是原理相同。</p>
<p>win具体的软件由pmvrotect2.x 3.x 3.5。vmp加密时只是对之前的so进行新增加密节区，不修改节区。</p>
<p>pmvrotect2软件加密的手段有很多最著名的是vmp技术。包含 指令虚拟化，导入表加密，反调试，反dump，指令和数据压缩</p>
<p>&nbsp;vmpdumper可以脱出汇编代码但是不能修复vmp节区和导出表，加密字符串。需要手动修复。导入表（IAT）不能修复</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>代码压缩 (Packing)</h3>
<p>原理：压缩代码段</p>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">原始PE结构:
<span class="line">├─ .text  (500KB) - 可执行代码
<span class="line">├─ .data  (100KB) - 数据
<span class="line">└─ .rsrc  (200KB) - 资源
<span class="line">
<span class="line">↓ 压缩后 ↓
<span class="line">
<span class="line">├─ .vmp0  (150KB) - 压缩的代码+解压stub
<span class="line">├─ .vmp1  (80KB)  - 压缩的数据  
<span class="line">└─ .rsrc  (200KB)
<span class="line">
<span class="line">运行时：
<span class="line">1. 解压.vmp0到内存
<span class="line">2. 修复重定位
<span class="line">3. 跳转执行</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>压缩算法：LZMA/自定义</p>
<p>强度：★★<br>主要用途：减小体积（附带混淆效果）</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>代码虚拟化 (Virtualization)&nbsp;⭐最强</h3>
<p>原理：将x86指令转换为自定义虚拟机指令</p>
<p>转换示例：</p>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">asm</span></div>









<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">; 原始代码
<span class="line">mov eax, 5
<span class="line">add eax, 3
<span class="line">ret
<span class="line">
<span class="line">; ↓ 虚拟化后 ↓
<span class="line">
<span class="line">push offset vm_bytecode  ; VM字节码
<span class="line">call vm_interpreter      ; 调用VM解释器
<span class="line">ret
<span class="line">
<span class="line">; vm_bytecode (自定义指令):
<span class="line">; 0x45 0x05 0x00 0x00 0x00  ; VM_MOV eax, 5
<span class="line">; 0x12 0x03 0x00 0x00 0x00  ; VM_ADD eax, 3
<span class="line">; 0xFF                      ; VM_RET</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>C代码示例：</p>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">C++</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">// 原始
<span class="line">int add(int a, int b) {
<span class="line">    return a + b;
<span class="line">}
<span class="line">
<span class="line">// SDK标记
<span class="line">#include "VMProtectSDK.h"
<span class="line">int add(int a, int b) {
<span class="line">    VMProtectBeginVirtualization("Add");
<span class="line">    return a + b;
<span class="line">    VMProtectEnd();
<span class="line">}</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>强度：★★★★★<br>性能损耗：5-20倍</p>
<div>&nbsp;
<h3>代码变异 (Mutation/Obfuscation)</h3>
<p>原理：用等价但复杂的指令替换原指令</p>
<p>转换示例：</p>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">asm</span></div>









<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">; 原始
<span class="line">mov eax, 5
<span class="line">
<span class="line">; ↓ 变异后 ↓
<span class="line">
<span class="line">push 2
<span class="line">push 3
<span class="line">pop ecx
<span class="line">pop edx
<span class="line">lea eax, [ecx+edx]  ; 实际还是5
<span class="line">
<span class="line">; 或者
<span class="line">
<span class="line">xor eax, eax
<span class="line">add eax, 3
<span class="line">inc eax
<span class="line">inc eax            ; 仍是5，但复杂化</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>典型变异技术：</p>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">asm</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">; 1. 指令替换
<span class="line">mov eax, 0  →  xor eax, eax
<span class="line">
<span class="line">; 2. 花指令插入
<span class="line">nop
<span class="line">jmp $+1
<span class="line">db 0xE8  ; 无效字节
<span class="line">add eax, ebx
<span class="line">
<span class="line">; 3. 寄存器替换
<span class="line">mov eax, 5  →  mov ebx, 5
<span class="line">                mov eax, ebx
<span class="line">
<span class="line">; 4. 常量加密
<span class="line">mov eax, 100  →  mov eax, 0x12345678
<span class="line">                 xor eax, 0x123456DC  ; = 100</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>强度：★★★★<br>性能损耗：1.5-3倍</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>









</div>
<p>&nbsp;导入表加密</p>
<h3>导入表保护 (Import Protection)</h3>
<p>原理：隐藏真实的API调用</p>
<p>转换示例：</p>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">C++</span></div>









<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">; 原始导入表
<span class="line">IMPORT TABLE:
<span class="line">  kernel32.dll
<span class="line">    - CreateFileA
<span class="line">    - ReadFile
<span class="line">
<span class="line">; ↓ 保护后 ↓
<span class="line">
<span class="line">IMPORT TABLE:
<span class="line">  kernel32.dll
<span class="line">    - LoadLibraryA  ; 只保留最基础的
<span class="line">
<span class="line">; 运行时动态获取
<span class="line">char* encrypted = "\x3F\x12\x7A...";  // 加密的 "CreateFileA"
<span class="line">decrypt(encrypted);
<span class="line">pCreateFile = GetProcAddress(LoadLibrary("kernel32"), decrypted);
<span class="line">pCreateFile(...);  // 调用</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>代码对比：</p>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">C++</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">// 原始
<span class="line">MessageBoxA(NULL, "Hello", "Test", 0);
<span class="line">
<span class="line">// 保护后（伪代码）
<span class="line">typedef int (WINAPI *pMsgBox)(HWND, LPCSTR, LPCSTR, UINT);
<span class="line">pMsgBox MyMsgBox = vmp_get_api(0x1A3F);  // 内部索引
<span class="line">MyMsgBox(NULL, vmp_str(0x2B4C), vmp_str(0x3D5E), 0);</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>强度：★★★★<br>绕过难度：中等（可API Hook监控）</p>
<p>&nbsp;call后面是加密的iat表</p>

<h3>字符串加密 (String Encryption)</h3>
<p>原理：加密所有字符串常量</p>
<p>示例：</p>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">C++</span></div>









<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">// 原始
<span class="line">const char* key = "MySecretKey123";
<span class="line">if (strcmp(input, key) == 0) { ... }
<span class="line">
<span class="line">// ↓ 加密后 ↓
<span class="line">
<span class="line">// 数据段存储
<span class="line">.data
<span class="line">encrypted_str db 0xA3,0x7F,0x2B,0x9C,... ; 加密的字符串
<span class="line">
<span class="line">// 代码中
<span class="line">char* key = vmp_decrypt_string(0x004050A0);
<span class="line">if (strcmp(input, key) == 0) {
<span class="line">    vmp_free_string(key);  // 用完立即清除
<span class="line">}</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>反调试 (Anti-Debug)</h3>
<p>技术清单：</p>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">C++</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">// 1. IsDebuggerPresent
<span class="line">if (IsDebuggerPresent()) {
<span class="line">    ExitProcess(0);
<span class="line">}
<span class="line">
<span class="line">// 2. PEB检测
<span class="line">bool CheckDebug() {
<span class="line">    __asm {
<span class="line">        mov eax, fs:[0x30]      // PEB
<span class="line">        movzx eax, byte ptr [eax+2]  // BeingDebugged
<span class="line">        test eax, eax
<span class="line">    }
<span class="line">}
<span class="line">
<span class="line">// 3. NtQueryInformationProcess
<span class="line">BOOL isDebug = FALSE;
<span class="line">NtQueryInformationProcess(GetCurrentProcess(), 
<span class="line">    ProcessDebugPort, &amp;isDebug, sizeof(BOOL), NULL);
<span class="line">
<span class="line">// 4. 时间检测
<span class="line">DWORD t1 = GetTickCount();
<span class="line">// 一些代码
<span class="line">DWORD t2 = GetTickCount();
<span class="line">if (t2 - t1 &gt; 1000) { /* 被调试 */ }
<span class="line">
<span class="line">// 5. 硬件断点检测
<span class="line">CONTEXT ctx = {0};
<span class="line">ctx.ContextFlags = CONTEXT_DEBUG_REGISTERS;
<span class="line">GetThreadContext(GetCurrentThread(), &amp;ctx);
<span class="line">if (ctx.Dr0 || ctx.Dr1 || ctx.Dr2 || ctx.Dr3) {
<span class="line">    /* 检测到硬件断点 */
<span class="line">}
<span class="line">
<span class="line">// 6. INT 3检测
<span class="line">__try {
<span class="line">    __asm int 3
<span class="line">} __except(EXCEPTION_EXECUTE_HANDLER) {
<span class="line">    // 正常程序会走这里
<span class="line">}
<span class="line">
<span class="line">// 7. 检测调试器窗口
<span class="line">if (FindWindow("OLLYDBG", NULL) || 
<span class="line">    FindWindow("WinDbgFrameClass", NULL)) {
<span class="line">    ExitProcess(0);
<span class="line">}</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code><br><br><br></pre>
<h3>反虚拟机 (Anti-VM)</h3>
<p>检测技术：</p>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">C++</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">// 1. CPUID检测
<span class="line">void CheckVM() {
<span class="line">    int cpuInfo[4];
<span class="line">    __cpuid(cpuInfo, 1);
<span class="line">    if (cpuInfo[2] &amp; (1 &lt;&lt; 31)) {
<span class="line">        // Hypervisor bit set
<span class="line">        ExitProcess(0);
<span class="line">    }
<span class="line">}
<span class="line">
<span class="line">// 2. 特征文件检测
<span class="line">if (PathFileExists("C:\\Windows\\System32\\drivers\\vmmouse.sys") ||
<span class="line">    PathFileExists("C:\\Windows\\System32\\drivers\\vmhgfs.sys")) {
<span class="line">    // VMware检测
<span class="line">}
<span class="line">
<span class="line">// 3. 注册表检测
<span class="line">HKEY hKey;
<span class="line">if (RegOpenKey(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, 
<span class="line">    "SOFTWARE\\VMware, Inc.\\VMware Tools", &amp;hKey) == ERROR_SUCCESS) {
<span class="line">    // VMware
<span class="line">}
<span class="line">
<span class="line">// 4. MAC地址检测
<span class="line">// VMware前缀: 00:05:69, 00:0C:29, 00:50:56
<span class="line">// VirtualBox前缀: 08:00:27
<span class="line">
<span class="line">// 5. 指令时间检测
<span class="line">DWORD t1 = __rdtsc();
<span class="line">// 执行一些指令
<span class="line">DWORD t2 = __rdtsc();
<span class="line">if (t2 - t1 &gt; threshold) { /* VM环境 */ }</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>强度：★★★<br>绕过：修改VM配置</p>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>

<h3>内存保护 (Memory Protection)</h3>
<p>原理：检测内存完整性</p>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">C++</span></div>









<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">// 1. CRC校验
<span class="line">DWORD original_crc = 0x12345678;
<span class="line">DWORD current_crc = calc_crc32(code_section, size);
<span class="line">if (current_crc != original_crc) {
<span class="line">    ExitProcess(0);  // 代码被修改
<span class="line">}
<span class="line">
<span class="line">// 2. 定期校验
<span class="line">void __stdcall CheckThread(LPVOID param) {
<span class="line">    while (true) {
<span class="line">        Sleep(1000);
<span class="line">        if (!verify_memory()) {
<span class="line">            TerminateProcess(GetCurrentProcess(), 0);
<span class="line">        }
<span class="line">    }
<span class="line">}
<span class="line">
<span class="line">// 3. 页面保护
<span class="line">VirtualProtect(code_section, size, PAGE_EXECUTE_READ, &amp;old);
<span class="line">// 任何写入会触发异常</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code><br><br><br><br></pre>
<h3>&nbsp;资源加密 (Resource Encryption)</h3>
<p>原理：加密PE资源段</p>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">C++</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">// 原始
<span class="line">HRSRC hRes = FindResource(NULL, MAKEINTRESOURCE(101), RT_BITMAP);
<span class="line">HGLOBAL hData = LoadResource(NULL, hRes);
<span class="line">void* pData = LockResource(hData);
<span class="line">
<span class="line">// ↓ 保护后 ↓
<span class="line">
<span class="line">// 资源段全部加密
<span class="line">.rsrc section: [encrypted data]
<span class="line">
<span class="line">// 运行时
<span class="line">HRSRC hRes = FindResource(...);
<span class="line">// VMProtect拦截LoadResource
<span class="line">HGLOBAL hData = LoadResource(...);  // 内部解密
<span class="line">void* pData = LockResource(hData);  // 返回解密数据</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>强度：★★★<br>效果：防止资源提取工具直接读取</p>









</div>









</div>









</div>
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"></pre>
<h3>应用VMProtect后（简化示意）</h3>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">C++</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">// 编译后的保护代码（逆向视角）
<span class="line">
<span class="line">.text:00401000  ; VMP Entry
<span class="line">.text:00401000  push    ebp
<span class="line">.text:00401001  call    vmp_init_2FA3C
<span class="line">.text:00401006  jmp     vm_dispatcher_1
<span class="line">
<span class="line">// 原始的main函数代码已经不存在
<span class="line">// 被转换为：
<span class="line">
<span class="line">.vmp0:00501000  db 0x4A, 0x8F, 0x23, ...  ; VM字节码
<span class="line">.vmp0:00501100  db 0x7C, 0x12, 0xAB, ...  
<span class="line">
<span class="line">.vmp1:00502000  ; VM解释器
<span class="line">.vmp1:00502000  vm_handler_0:
<span class="line">.vmp1:00502000      mov al, [esi]
<span class="line">.vmp1:00502002      inc esi
<span class="line">.vmp1:00502003      movzx eax, al
<span class="line">.vmp1:00502006      jmp [vm_table + eax*4]
<span class="line">
<span class="line">// 字符串也被加密
<span class="line">.data:00601000  encrypted_str1  db 0xA4,0x7F,0x9C,...
<span class="line">.data:00601020  encrypted_str2  db 0x3E,0x12,0x88,...
<span class="line">
<span class="line">// 导入表被隐藏
<span class="line">.idata:00701000  ; 只剩下
<span class="line">.idata:00701000  dd offset LoadLibraryA
<span class="line">.idata:00701004  dd offset GetProcAddress</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>

<p>虚拟指令、虚拟栈、虚拟寄存器。</p>

<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1082680/202510/1082680-20251025175923286-973145267.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>msdn。开发文档<br>&lt;windows程序设计&gt;<br>&lt;windows核心编程&gt;<br>&lt;win32汇编语言程序设计&gt;</p>

<h3>PE 文件结构图例</h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">text</span></div>



















</div>



















</div>



















</div>
<pre>+-----------------------------------+  &lt;-- 文件开始 (Offset 0)
|        IMAGE_DOS_HEADER           |
|-----------------------------------|
|   - e_magic: "MZ" (0x5A4D)        |  &lt;- DOS 可执行文件签名
|   - e_lfanew: 指向 NT 头部的偏移量 |  &lt;- 这是通往 PE 头的关键指针！
+-----------------------------------+
|         DOS Stub Program          |  &lt;- 一小段 DOS 程序，通常显示 "This program cannot be run in DOS mode."
+-----------------------------------+  &lt;-- e_lfanew 指向的位置
|        IMAGE_NT_HEADERS           |
|   +-----------------------------+  |
|   |         Signature           |  |
|   | - "PE\0\0" (0x00004550)     |  |  &lt;- PE 文件签名
|   +-----------------------------+  |
|   |    IMAGE_FILE_HEADER        |  |
|   |-----------------------------|  |
|   | - Machine: (e.g., 0x8664)   |  |  &lt;- 目标 CPU 架构 (如 x64)
|   | - NumberOfSections:         |  |  &lt;- 后面跟着的节区数量
|   | - TimeDateStamp:            |  |  &lt;- 链接时间戳
|   | - SizeOfOptionalHeader:     |  |  &lt;- 下一个头的大小
|   | - Characteristics:          |  |  &lt;- 文件属性 (如 DLL, Executable)
|   +-----------------------------+  |
|   |  IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER      |  |  &lt;- 对于操作系统加载器至关重要
|   |-----------------------------|  |
|   | - Magic: (e.g., 0x20B)      |  |  &lt;- 标识 PE32(0x10B) 或 PE32+(0x20B)
|   | - AddressOfEntryPoint:      |  |  &lt;- 程序执行入口 RVA
|   | - ImageBase:                |  |  &lt;- 映像的首选加载地址
|   | - SectionAlignment:         |  |  &lt;- 内存中节区的对齐方式
|   | - FileAlignment:            |  |  &lt;- 文件中节区的对齐方式
|   | - SizeOfImage:              |  |  &lt;- 内存中整个映像的大小
|   | - SizeOfHeaders:            |  |  &lt;- 所有头部的总大小
|   | - Subsystem: (e.g., GUI/CUI) |  |  &lt;- 要求子系统 (如 Windows GUI)
|   | - NumberOfRvaAndSizes:      |  |  &lt;- 数据目录项的数量
|   |-----------------------------|  |
|   |   IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY      |  |  &lt;- 一个结构体数组
|   |   [0] Export Directory      |  |
|   |   [1] Import Directory      |  |  &lt;- 指向导入函数信息
|   |   [2] Resource Directory    |  |  &lt;- 指向资源 (图标、字符串等)
|   |   [3] Exception Directory   |  |
|   |   ... (共 16 个) ...        |  |
|   +-----------------------------+  |
+-----------------------------------+
|     IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER[0]       |  &lt;- 第一个节区头 (如 .text)
|   - Name: ".text\0\0\0"           |  &lt;- 节区名称
|   - VirtualAddress:               |  &lt;- 内存中的 RVA
|   - SizeOfRawData:                |  &lt;- 在文件中的大小
|   - PointerToRawData:             |  &lt;- 在文件中的偏移
|   - Characteristics:              |  &lt;- 节区属性 (如 可执行、可读)
+-----------------------------------+
|     IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER[1]       |  &lt;- 第二个节区头 (如 .data)
|   - Name: ".data\0\0\0"           |
|   - ...                           |
+-----------------------------------+
|             ...                   |  &lt;- 其他节区头 (共 NumberOfSections 个)
+-----------------------------------+  &lt;-- SizeOfHeaders 标记的头部结束位置
|         节区数据开始               |
|                                   |
|        .text 节区原始数据          |  &lt;- 文件偏移由 PointerToRawData 指定
|        (存放代码)                  |
|                                   |
|        .data 节区原始数据          |  &lt;- 文件偏移由 PointerToRawData 指定
|        (存放全局变量)              |
|                                   |
|        .rsrc 节区原始数据          |
|        (存放资源)                  |
|                                   |
|             ...                   |
+-----------------------------------+  &lt;-- 文件结束</pre>
</div>
<hr>
<h3>各组成部分的简明解释</h3>
<ol start="1">
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">IMAGE_DOS_HEADER (DOS 头)</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">目的：为了保持与古老 DOS 系统的兼容性。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">关键成员：<code>e_lfanew</code>&nbsp;字段，它包含了指向真正的 PE 头 (<code>IMAGE_NT_HEADERS</code>) 的文件偏移量。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">IMAGE_NT_HEADERS (NT 头)</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">目的：PE 文件的正式入口和核心描述符。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">包含三部分：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">Signature：一个 "PE\0\0" 的签名，标识这是一个 PE 文件。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">IMAGE_FILE_HEADER (文件头)：描述了文件的全局属性，如目标机器类型、节区数量、创建时间等。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER (可选头)：虽然叫"可选"，但对于可执行文件是必需的。它包含了程序加载和运行所需的关键信息。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER (可选头)</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">目的：为操作系统加载器提供如何准备和执行程序的信息。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">关键成员：入口点地址、映像基址、内存/文件对齐值、子系统等。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">它末尾的&nbsp;IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY (数据目录)&nbsp;是一个非常重要的表格，它指出了其他重要数据结构（如导入表、导出表、资源表）在文件中的位置和大小。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY (数据目录)</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">目的：作为指向其他重要数据的“目录”或“索引”。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">结构：一个由16个相同结构组成的数组。每个结构包含一个&nbsp;RVA（相对虚拟地址）&nbsp;和&nbsp;Size。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">例如：第二个条目（索引1）是&nbsp;Import Directory，加载器通过它找到所有需要从其他DLL导入的函数列表。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER (节区头)</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">目的：描述文件中的各个“节区”。节区是实际存储代码、数据、资源等内容的部分。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">数量：由&nbsp;<code>IMAGE_FILE_HEADER</code>&nbsp;中的&nbsp;<code>NumberOfSections</code>&nbsp;指定。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">关键成员：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><code>Name</code>：节区名称（如&nbsp;<code>.text</code>,&nbsp;<code>.data</code>,&nbsp;<code>.rdata</code>）。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><code>VirtualAddress</code>：该节区加载到内存后的 RVA。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><code>PointerToRawData</code>：该节区在磁盘文件中的原始数据偏移。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><code>Characteristics</code>：节区属性（如可读、可写、可执行）。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<h3>总结与流程</h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">操作系统加载一个 PE 文件的简化流程如下：</p>
<ol start="1">
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">读取&nbsp;<code>IMAGE_DOS_HEADER</code>，找到&nbsp;<code>e_lfanew</code>。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">跳到&nbsp;<code>e_lfanew</code>&nbsp;位置，验证 "PE" 签名，读取&nbsp;<code>IMAGE_NT_HEADERS</code>。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">从&nbsp;<code>IMAGE_FILE_HEADER</code>&nbsp;知道有多少个节区。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">从&nbsp;<code>IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER</code>&nbsp;获取关键信息（如入口点、映像大小、数据目录）。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">遍历&nbsp;<code>IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER</code>&nbsp;数组，了解每个节区在文件和内存中的映射关系。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">根据节区头的信息，将文件的各个节区（代码、数据等）映射到内存的相应位置。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">通过&nbsp;<code>IMAGE_DATA_DIRECTORY</code>&nbsp;找到导入表，解析并填充所有需要的外部函数地址。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">最后，跳转到&nbsp;<code>AddressOfEntryPoint</code>&nbsp;指向的地址，程序开始执行。</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">这个结构确保了 PE 文件既能在磁盘上高效存储，又能在内存中正确加载和执行。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

<span class="line">│                   你写的代码在这里                        │
<span class="line">│                                                         │
<span class="line">├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
<span class="line">│                   Section 2 (.data)                     │  ← 数据区
<span class="line">│                   全局变量在这里                          │
<span class="line">├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
<span class="line">│                   Section 3 (.rsrc)                     │  ← 资源区
<span class="line">│                   图标、对话框、字符串在这里               │
<span class="line">└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<hr>
<h2>🔍 详细结构拆解</h2>
<h3>1️⃣ DOS Header (IMAGE_DOS_HEADER)</h3>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">偏移    大小    字段名              白话文解释
<span class="line">+0x00   2字节   e_magic            "MZ" 标记（0x5A4D）—— 所有PE文件必须以这两个字母开头
<span class="line">+0x02   58字节  [其他DOS字段]       基本没用，为了兼容古董DOS系统
<span class="line">+0x3C   4字节   e_lfanew           **超重要！** 指向真正的PE头在哪里</span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>白话：</p>
<blockquote>
<p>这是个"假门面"，为了让Windows程序能在老DOS系统上显示错误提示，而不是直接崩溃。<br>最重要的是最后那个&nbsp;<code class="rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-surface-tertiary font-mono text-[0.9em] text-text-primary font-medium">e_lfanew</code>，它告诉系统："真正的PE头在文件偏移XXX处"。</p>



















</blockquote>
<hr>
<h3>2️⃣ PE Signature (4字节)</h3>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>



















<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words">+0x00   4字节   Signature          "PE\0\0" (0x50450000)</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>白话：</p>
<blockquote>
<p>就像盖了个"认证章"，证明"我是正宗的Windows程序"。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h3>3️⃣ File Header (IMAGE_FILE_HEADER - 20字节)</h3>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">偏移    大小    字段名                  白话文解释
<span class="line">+0x00   2字节   Machine                CPU类型（0x14C=x86, 0x8664=x64）
<span class="line">+0x02   2字节   NumberOfSections       这个程序有几个"节"（通常3-6个）
<span class="line">+0x04   4字节   TimeDateStamp          程序编译的时间戳
<span class="line">+0x08   4字节   PointerToSymbolTable   调试符号表位置（发布版通常是0）
<span class="line">+0x0C   4字节   NumberOfSymbols        符号数量
<span class="line">+0x10   2字节   SizeOfOptionalHeader   下一个头的大小（32位=224, 64位=240）
<span class="line">+0x12   2字节   Characteristics        文件属性标志</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>白话：</p>
<blockquote>
<p>这是"身份证"部分：</p>
<ul>
<li>告诉系统这是32位还是64位程序</li>
<li>有几个代码/数据分区</li>
<li>什么时候编译的</li>
<li>是个EXE还是DLL（Characteristics字段）</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<p>Characteristics 常见标志：</p>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">0x0002  IMAGE_FILE_EXECUTABLE_IMAGE     可执行文件（不是obj）
<span class="line">0x0100  IMAGE_FILE_32BIT_MACHINE        32位程序
<span class="line">0x2000  IMAGE_FILE_DLL                  这是个DLL文件</span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<hr>
<h3>4️⃣ Optional Header (IMAGE_OPTIONAL_HEADER - 最重要！)</h3>
<h4>标准字段部分</h4>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">偏移    大小    字段名                  白话文解释
<span class="line">+0x00   2字节   Magic                  0x10B(32位) / 0x20B(64位)
<span class="line">+0x02   1字节   MajorLinkerVersion     编译器版本
<span class="line">+0x03   1字节   MinorLinkerVersion
<span class="line">+0x04   4字节   SizeOfCode             代码段总大小
<span class="line">+0x08   4字节   SizeOfInitializedData  已初始化数据大小
<span class="line">+0x0C   4字节   SizeOfUninitializedData未初始化数据大小
<span class="line">+0x10   4字节   AddressOfEntryPoint    **入口点！程序从这里开始执行**
<span class="line">+0x14   4字节   BaseOfCode             代码段起始地址
<span class="line">+0x18   4字节   BaseOfData             数据段起始地址（仅32位）</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<h4>Windows专用字段部分</h4>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">偏移    大小    字段名                  白话文解释
<span class="line">+0x1C   4/8字节 ImageBase              程序希望加载到内存的哪个地址
<span class="line">+0x20   4字节   SectionAlignment       节在内存中的对齐单位（通常0x1000=4KB）
<span class="line">+0x24   4字节   FileAlignment          节在文件中的对齐单位（通常0x200=512字节）
<span class="line">+0x28   8字节   [操作系统版本号]
<span class="line">+0x30   8字节   [程序版本号]
<span class="line">+0x38   8字节   [子系统版本号]
<span class="line">+0x40   4字节   Win32VersionValue      保留（总是0）
<span class="line">+0x44   4字节   SizeOfImage            程序加载到内存后的总大小
<span class="line">+0x48   4字节   SizeOfHeaders          所有头的总大小
<span class="line">+0x4C   4字节   CheckSum               校验和（驱动必须正确，普通程序可为0）
<span class="line">+0x50   2字节   Subsystem              子系统类型
<span class="line">+0x52   2字节   DllCharacteristics     DLL特性标志
<span class="line">+0x54   16字节  [栈/堆大小设置]
<span class="line">+0x64   4字节   NumberOfRvaAndSizes    数据目录数量（通常是16）</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>Subsystem 子系统：</p>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">1 = Native（驱动程序）
<span class="line">2 = GUI（窗口程序）
<span class="line">3 = CUI（控制台程序，黑框框）</span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>DllCharacteristics 重要标志：</p>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">0x0040  DYNAMIC_BASE           支持ASLR（地址随机化）
<span class="line">0x0100  NX_COMPAT              支持DEP（数据执行保护）
<span class="line">0x0400  NO_SEH                 不使用SEH异常处理
<span class="line">0x8000  TERMINAL_SERVER_AWARE  终端服务器感知</span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<hr>
<h3>5️⃣ 数据目录表 (Data Directory - 16个条目)</h3>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">索引  名称                        作用
<span class="line">[0]   Export Table              导出表（DLL导出的函数列表）
<span class="line">[1]   Import Table              导入表（程序要用哪些DLL的哪些函数）
<span class="line">[2]   Resource Table            资源表（图标、字符串、对话框）
<span class="line">[3]   Exception Table           异常处理表
<span class="line">[4]   Certificate Table         数字签名
<span class="line">[5]   Base Relocation Table     重定位表（修正地址用）
<span class="line">[6]   Debug                     调试信息
<span class="line">[7]   Architecture              架构特定数据
<span class="line">[8]   Global Ptr                全局指针寄存器
<span class="line">[9]   TLS Table                 线程局部存储
<span class="line">[10]  Load Config Table         加载配置
<span class="line">[11]  Bound Import              绑定导入
<span class="line">[12]  IAT                       导入地址表（最常被破解者关注！）
<span class="line">[13]  Delay Import Descriptor   延迟导入
<span class="line">[14]  CLR Runtime Header        .NET程序专用
<span class="line">[15]  Reserved                  保留</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>每个条目结构：</p>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">+0x00  4字节  VirtualAddress    数据在内存中的RVA
<span class="line">+0x04  4字节  Size              数据的大小</span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<hr>
<h3>6️⃣ 节表 (Section Table - 每节40字节)</h3>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">偏移    大小    字段名              白话文解释
<span class="line">+0x00   8字节   Name               节名称（如".text"、".data"）
<span class="line">+0x08   4字节   VirtualSize        在内存中的实际大小
<span class="line">+0x0C   4字节   VirtualAddress     在内存中的起始地址(RVA)
<span class="line">+0x10   4字节   SizeOfRawData      在文件中的大小
<span class="line">+0x14   4字节   PointerToRawData   在文件中的偏移
<span class="line">+0x18   12字节  [重定位/行号信息]   通常为0
<span class="line">+0x24   4字节   Characteristics    节的属性（可读/可写/可执行）</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>常见节名称：</p>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">.text   代码段（你的程序逻辑）          可读+可执行
<span class="line">.data   已初始化数据（全局变量）        可读+可写
<span class="line">.rdata  只读数据（常量字符串）          只读
<span class="line">.bss    未初始化数据                   可读+可写
<span class="line">.rsrc   资源（图标、菜单、字符串）      只读
<span class="line">.reloc  重定位信息                     只读
<span class="line">.idata  导入表（需要的DLL函数）        可读+可写
<span class="line">.edata  导出表（DLL导出的函数）        只读</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<p>Characteristics 节属性：</p>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">0x00000020  CODE                 包含代码
<span class="line">0x00000040  INITIALIZED_DATA     包含已初始化数据
<span class="line">0x00000080  UNINITIALIZED_DATA   包含未初始化数据
<span class="line">0x20000000  EXECUTE              可执行
<span class="line">0x40000000  READ                 可读
<span class="line">0x80000000  WRITE                可写</span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<hr>
<h2>🎯 关键概念白话解释</h2>
<h3>RVA (Relative Virtual Address) - 相对虚拟地址</h3>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">假设程序被加载到内存地址 0x00400000
<span class="line">某个函数的RVA是 0x1000
<span class="line">那么这个函数的实际内存地址 = 0x00400000 + 0x1000 = 0x00401000</span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<h3>文件偏移 vs 内存地址</h3>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">文件偏移：在硬盘上的.exe文件中的位置
<span class="line">内存地址：程序运行时在内存中的位置
<span class="line">需要通过节表来转换！</span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<h3>对齐 (Alignment)</h3>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">FileAlignment = 0x200 (512字节)
<span class="line">→ 文件中每个节的起始位置必须是512的倍数
<span class="line">
<span class="line">SectionAlignment = 0x1000 (4096字节)
<span class="line">→ 内存中每个节的起始位置必须是4KB的倍数</span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<hr>
<h2>🛠️ 实战：用十六进制编辑器看PE头</h2>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">偏移      十六进制                            解释
<span class="line">00000000: 4D 5A 90 00 03 00 00 00...         MZ = DOS头开始
<span class="line">0000003C: E0 00 00 00                         e_lfanew = 0xE0
<span class="line">000000E0: 50 45 00 00                         PE签名
<span class="line">000000E4: 4C 01 06 00                         Machine=0x014C(x86), Sections=6
<span class="line">000000F8: 0B 01                               Magic=0x10B(32位)
<span class="line">00000100: 00 10 00 00                         AddressOfEntryPoint=0x1000</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<hr>
<h2>📝 总结：PE头三句话秒懂</h2>
<ol>
<li>DOS头："我伪装成DOS程序，但真正的内容在后面"</li>
<li>PE头："我是Windows程序，32位/64位，从地址XXX开始执行"</li>
<li>节表："我的代码在.text节，数据在.data节，资源在.rsrc节"</li>
</ol><hr>
<h2>🔥 最关心的地方</h2>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>

<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">✅ AddressOfEntryPoint    → 程序从哪里开始跑
<span class="line">✅ Import Table (IAT)     → 调用了哪些关键API（MessageBox? RegCreateKey?）
<span class="line">✅ .text 节               → 注册验证代码藏在这里
<span class="line">✅ Characteristics        → 能不能改这个节的数据
<span class="line">✅ Resource Table         → 修改图标、字符串、对话框</span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>

<ul>
<li>CFF Explorer&nbsp;(查看PE结构最直观)</li>
