<h4>x64dbg 配置示例</h4>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">1. 安装 ScyllaHide 插件
<span class="line">   - 下载 ScyllaHide.zip
<span class="line">   - 解压到 x64dbg\plugins\
<span class="line">   - 重启 x64dbg
<span class="line">   - 插件 → ScyllaHide → Options
<span class="line">   - 勾选所有反调试对抗选项：
<span class="line">     ✓ NtQueryInformationProcess
<span class="line">     ✓ NtQuerySystemInformation
<span class="line">     ✓ NtSetInformationThread
<span class="line">     ✓ NtClose
<span class="line">     ✓ OutputDebugString
<span class="line">     ✓ GetTickCount
<span class="line">     ✓ ...
<span class="line">
<span class="line">2. 配置选项
<span class="line">   - 选项 → 首选项 → 异常
<span class="line">     ✓ 忽略所有异常（第一轮）
<span class="line">   - 选项 → 首选项 → 引擎
<span class="line">     ✓ 禁用调试特权
<span class="line">     ✓ 保存数据库
<span class="line">
<span class="line">3. 安装 Scylla
<span class="line">   - 插件 → Scylla → Hide from PEB</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<hr>
<h3>2.3 阶段二：定位 OEP (真实入口点)</h3>
<h4>方法1: ESP 定律（最常用）</h4>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">原理：
<span class="line">VMP的壳代码执行完后，会用类似 RETN 的指令跳转到OEP
<span class="line">此时ESP指向的栈位置存放着OEP地址
<span class="line">
<span class="line">步骤：
<span class="line">1. x64dbg 加载程序（暂停在系统断点）
<span class="line">
<span class="line">2. 命令行执行：
<span class="line">   bp GetProcAddress  // 或者 bp LoadLibraryA
<span class="line">   F9 运行
<span class="line">
<span class="line">3. 断下后，在命令行：
<span class="line">   hr esp             // 对ESP指向的内存地址下硬件访问断点
<span class="line">   
<span class="line">4. F9 继续运行
<span class="line">
<span class="line">5. 程序会在访问这个栈地址时断下
<span class="line">   观察此时的指令，通常是：
<span class="line">   PUSH xxxxxxxx
<span class="line">   RETN              ← 断在这里
<span class="line">   
<span class="line">6. 单步执行 (F7)，会跳转到一个新地址
<span class="line">   此时查看代码，如果看到：
<span class="line">   - 正常的函数序言（PUSH EBP; MOV EBP,ESP）
<span class="line">   - 或者开始调用API
<span class="line">   - 代码段名称变成 .text
<span class="line">   → 这就是 OEP！
<span class="line">
<span class="line">7. 记录当前地址，例如：00401000</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<h4>方法2: 内存断点法</h4>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">步骤：
<span class="line">1. 运行程序，在 x64dbg 中打开内存映射 (Alt+M)
<span class="line">
<span class="line">2. 找到 .text 节（代码段）
<span class="line">   - 名称：.text
<span class="line">   - 权限：ER-（可执行，可读）
<span class="line">   - 大小：通常最大的可执行段
<span class="line">
<span class="line">3. 右键 → 在反汇编中转到 → 地址
<span class="line">   记录起始地址，例如：00401000
<span class="line">
<span class="line">4. 在命令行设置内存访问断点：
<span class="line">   bpm 00401000, 1, x    // 在00401000地址，1字节，执行时中断
<span class="line">   
<span class="line">5. F9 运行，当第一次执行 .text 段代码时会断下
<span class="line">   → 这通常就是 OEP 附近
<span class="line">
<span class="line">注意：VMP可能会在OEP前多次访问.text段进行完整性检查</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<h4>方法3: 异常断点法</h4>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">原理：VMP使用大量异常作为混淆手段，最后一个异常通常在OEP附近
<span class="line">
<span class="line">步骤：
<span class="line">1. x64dbg → 选项 → 首选项 → 异常
<span class="line">   - 取消"忽略所有异常"
<span class="line">   - 只保留"忽略INT 3"
<span class="line">
<span class="line">2. F9 运行，每次异常断下时：
<span class="line">   - 查看当前位置是否在 .text 段
<span class="line">   - 如果不是，按 Shift+F9 传递异常
<span class="line">   
<span class="line">3. 重复多次后，最终会停在接近OEP的地方
<span class="line">
<span class="line">4. 配合反汇编判断是否为OEP</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<h4>如何确认找到的是真正的 OEP？</h4>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">特征检查清单:
<span class="line">✓ 代码段名称是 .text 或 CODE
<span class="line">✓ 可以看到清晰的函数调用（CALL API）
<span class="line">✓ 有正常的函数序言：
<span class="line">    PUSH EBP
<span class="line">    MOV EBP, ESP
<span class="line">    SUB ESP, xxx
<span class="line">✓ 或者是 WinMain 的标准开头：
<span class="line">    PUSH EBX
<span class="line">    PUSH ESI
<span class="line">    PUSH EDI
<span class="line">✓ 附近有字符串引用
<span class="line">✓ IDA Pro F5能正常反编译
<span class="line">✓ 地址接近PE头中的 AddressOfEntryPoint（但不完全相同）</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<hr>
<h3>2.4 阶段三：Dump 内存镜像</h3>
<h4>使用 Scylla 进行 Dump</h4>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">步骤：
<span class="line">1. 在 OEP 处暂停程序（上一步已找到）
<span class="line">
<span class="line">2. x64dbg → 插件 → Scylla
<span class="line">
<span class="line">3. Scylla 窗口设置：
<span class="line">   [*] Attach to: [选择目标进程]
<span class="line">   [*] OEP: 00001000    ← 输入相对于ImageBase的偏移
<span class="line">   [*] IAT AutoSearch   ← 自动搜索导入表
<span class="line">   
<span class="line">4. 点击 "IAT Autosearch"
<span class="line">   - 如果成功，会显示：
<span class="line">     Found IAT: 00402000 (Size: 0x400)
<span class="line">
<span class="line">5. 点击 "Get Imports"
<span class="line">   - Scylla会分析IAT，列出所有导入函数
<span class="line">   - 检查是否有 "invalid" 标记的项
<span class="line">   
<span class="line">6. 如果有invalid项：
<span class="line">   - 右键 → Cut Thunk
<span class="line">   - 或手动修复
<span class="line">
<span class="line">7. 点击 "Dump"
<span class="line">   - 选择保存位置，例如：dumped.exe
<span class="line">
<span class="line">8. 点击 "Fix Dump"
<span class="line">   - 选择刚才保存的 dumped.exe
<span class="line">   - Scylla会修复IAT并生成 dumped_SCY.exe</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<h4>手动 Dump (OllyDumpEx)</h4>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">在 OllyDbg 中:
<span class="line">1. 插件 → OllyDumpEx
<span class="line">
<span class="line">2. 设置参数：
<span class="line">   Base Address: 00400000    ← 从内存窗口查看
<span class="line">   Entry Point:  00001000    ← OEP的RVA
<span class="line">   Size:         00050000    ← 从PE头SizeOfImage获取
<span class="line">   
<span class="line">3. 勾选选项：
<span class="line">   ✓ Rebuild Import
<span class="line">   ✓ Fix Dump
<span class="line">   
<span class="line">4. 点击 "Dump" 保存
<span class="line">
<span class="line">注意：手动dump可能需要后续修复重定位表</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<hr>
<h3>2.5 阶段四：修复导入表 (IAT Fix)</h3>
<h4>IAT修复原理</h4>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">正常程序的IAT:
<span class="line">┌──────────────────────────┐
<span class="line">│ .idata 节                 │
<span class="line">├──────────────────────────┤
<span class="line">│ Import Directory         │
<span class="line">│  DLL: kernel32.dll       │
<span class="line">│  Thunk Array:            │
<span class="line">│    → CreateFileA         │
<span class="line">│    → ReadFile            │
<span class="line">│    → CloseHandle         │
<span class="line">├──────────────────────────┤
<span class="line">│ IAT (导入地址表)          │
<span class="line">│  0x402000: 76A81234  ← CreateFileA的真实地址
<span class="line">│  0x402004: 76A85678  ← ReadFile的真实地址
<span class="line">│  0x402008: 76A89ABC  ← CloseHandle的真实地址
<span class="line">└──────────────────────────┘
<span class="line">
<span class="line">VMP加密后:
<span class="line">┌──────────────────────────┐
<span class="line">│ Import Directory 被破坏   │
<span class="line">│  或指向假数据             │
<span class="line">├──────────────────────────┤
<span class="line">│ IAT 被加密/动态生成       │
<span class="line">│  0x402000: 00000000      │
<span class="line">│  运行时才填充真实地址     │
<span class="line">└──────────────────────────┘
<span class="line">
<span class="line">修复目标:
<span class="line">重建 Import Directory 和 IAT，使dump出的文件能独立运行</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<h4>Scylla 自动修复</h4>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">1. "IAT Autosearch" 原理：
<span class="line">   - 在OEP附近扫描内存
<span class="line">   - 查找连续的、指向DLL代码段的指针
<span class="line">   - 识别为IAT
<span class="line">
<span class="line">2. "Get Imports" 原理：
<span class="line">   - 读取IAT中的地址
<span class="line">   - 通过地址找到对应的DLL模块
<span class="line">   - 在DLL的导出表中查找函数名
<span class="line">   - 重建导入表
<span class="line">
<span class="line">3. 常见问题及解决：
<span class="line">   
<span class="line">   问题1: "Found invalid imports"
<span class="line">   原因：某些地址不是真正的API地址
<span class="line">   解决：右键 → Cut Thunk (删除)
<span class="line">   
<span class="line">   问题2: "IAT not found"
<span class="line">   原因：IAT被严重混淆
<span class="line">   解决：手动搜索
<span class="line">     - 在OEP处下断点
<span class="line">     - 运行程序，观察哪些API被调用
<span class="line">     - 在内存中搜索这些API的地址
<span class="line">     - 找到IAT的大致范围后，手动指定</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<h4>手动修复 IAT（高级）</h4>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">工具：IDA Pro + IDAPython
<span class="line">
<span class="line">脚本示例：
<span class="line">import idaapi
<span class="line">import idc
<span class="line">
<span class="line">def rebuild_iat(start, end):
<span class="line">    """重建IAT"""
<span class="line">    addr = start
<span class="line">    imports = []
<span class="line">    
<span class="line">    while addr &lt; end:
<span class="line">        # 读取指针
<span class="line">        ptr = idc.get_qword(addr) if idaapi.get_inf_structure().is_64bit() \
<span class="line">              else idc.get_wide_dword(addr)
<span class="line">        
<span class="line">        # 检查是否指向DLL代码
<span class="line">        seg = idaapi.getseg(ptr)
<span class="line">        if seg and seg.type == idaapi.SEG_XTRN:
<span class="line">            # 获取函数名
<span class="line">            name = idc.get_name(ptr)
<span class="line">            if name:
<span class="line">                imports.append((addr, name))
<span class="line">                print(f"{hex(addr)}: {name}")
<span class="line">        
<span class="line">        addr += 4 if not idaapi.get_inf_structure().is_64bit() else 8
<span class="line">    
<span class="line">    return imports
<span class="line">
<span class="line"># 使用
<span class="line">iat_start = 0x00402000  # 手动确定的IAT起始
<span class="line">iat_end = 0x00402400    # 手动确定的IAT结束
<span class="line">rebuild_iat(iat_start, iat_end)</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<hr>
<h3>2.6 阶段五：去虚拟化 (De-virtualization) - 核心难点</h3>
<h4>5.1 识别 VM Entry</h4>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">特征码搜索法:
<span class="line">在IDA Pro中搜索以下特征：
<span class="line">
<span class="line">特征1: 大量 PUSHFD / PUSHAD (保存寄存器)
<span class="line">60                    PUSHAD
<span class="line">9C                    PUSHFD
<span class="line">...
<span class="line">大量MOV/PUSH操作
<span class="line">...
<span class="line">
<span class="line">特征2: 跳转到动态计算的地址
<span class="line">MOV EAX, [EBP+var_XX]
<span class="line">JMP [EAX*4+table_base]   ← VM Dispatcher
<span class="line">
<span class="line">特征3: 大量的RET链
<span class="line">RETN
<span class="line">RETN
<span class="line">RETN  ← 每个Handler结束都用RETN返回Dispatcher
<span class="line">
<span class="line">手动识别：
<span class="line">1. 从OEP开始F5查看
<span class="line">2. 如果看到极其复杂的代码，无法理解的嵌套
<span class="line">3. 大量单字节变量操作
<span class="line">4. 频繁的函数调用但没有明显逻辑
<span class="line">→ 这些都是VM化的代码</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<h4>5.2 分析 VM 架构</h4>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">目标：理解这个虚拟机的"指令集"
<span class="line">
<span class="line">┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
<span class="line">│          VM 架构分析清单                 │
<span class="line">├─────────────────────────────────────────┤
<span class="line">│ 1. 虚拟寄存器 (Virtual Registers)        │
<span class="line">│    - 在哪里存储？（栈上/全局内存）       │
<span class="line">│    - 有多少个？（通常8-16个）            │
<span class="line">│    - 如何访问？                          │
<span class="line">├─────────────────────────────────────────┤
<span class="line">│ 2. 虚拟栈 (Virtual Stack)                │
<span class="line">│    - Stack Pointer 在哪？                │
<span class="line">│    - PUSH/POP 如何实现？                 │
<span class="line">├─────────────────────────────────────────┤
<span class="line">│ 3. 字节码 (Bytecode)                     │
<span class="line">│    - 存储位置                            │
<span class="line">│    - 读取方式                            │
<span class="line">│    - 格式：定长？变长？                  │
<span class="line">├─────────────────────────────────────────┤
<span class="line">│ 4. Dispatcher (调度器)                   │
<span class="line">│    - 入口地址                            │
<span class="line">│    - 解码逻辑                            │
<span class="line">│    - 跳转表结构                          │
<span class="line">├─────────────────────────────────────────┤
<span class="line">│ 5. Handlers (处理器)                     │
<span class="line">│    - 数量统计                            │
<span class="line">│    - 功能分类                            │
<span class="line">│    - 参数传递方式                        │
<span class="line">└─────────────────────────────────────────┘</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<h4>5.3 提取 VM Handlers</h4>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">方法：动态跟踪 + 静态分析结合
<span class="line">
<span class="line">x64dbg 脚本示例：
<span class="line">--------------------
<span class="line">// 在 Dispatcher 下断点
<span class="line">bp 00401234  // Dispatcher地址
<span class="line">
<span class="line">// 记录每个Handler
<span class="line">var handler_list
<span class="line">log "Opcode, Handler Address"
<span class="line">
<span class="line">loop:
<span class="line">    run
<span class="line">    mov eax, [esp]        // 假设栈顶是返回地址
<span class="line">    mov ebx, [ebp+opcode] // 假设EBP+offset存放opcode
<span class="line">    log "{ebx}, {eax}"
<span class="line">    esti                  // 执行直到返回
<span class="line">    jmp loop
<span class="line">--------------------
<span class="line">
<span class="line">输出示例：
<span class="line">Opcode, Handler Address
<span class="line">0x01, 0x00401500  ← Handler_01
<span class="line">0x02, 0x00401650  ← Handler_02
<span class="line">0x03, 0x004017A0  ← Handler_03
<span class="line">...
<span class="line">
<span class="line">然后在IDA中逐个分析这些地址的代码</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<h4>5.4 反编译字节码</h4>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">步骤一：提取字节码
<span class="line">-----------------
<span class="line">x64dbg内存dump：
<span class="line">1. 运行到VM Entry后断下
<span class="line">2. 在dump窗口，找到字节码起始地址（通常从某个寄存器得到）
<span class="line">   例如：EBP+0x100 指向字节码
<span class="line">3. 右键 → Dump Memory to File
<span class="line">4. 保存为 bytecode.bin
<span class="line">
<span class="line">步骤二：编写反编译器
<span class="line">-------------------
<span class="line">Python示例：
<span class="line">
<span class="line">class VMDecompiler:
<span class="line">    def __init__(self, bytecode_file):
<span class="line">        with open(bytecode_file, 'rb') as f:
<span class="line">            self.bytecode = f.read()
<span class="line">        self.pc = 0  # Program Counter
<span class="line">        
<span class="line">        # Handler映射表（需手动填充）
<span class="line">        self.handlers = {
<span class="line">            0x01: self.vm_push,
<span class="line">            0x02: self.vm_pop,
<span class="line">            0x03: self.vm_add,
<span class="line">            0x04: self.vm_sub,
<span class="line">            0x05: self.vm_mov,
<span class="line">            0x10: self.vm_cmp,
<span class="line">            0x11: self.vm_jne,
<span class="line">            # ... 更多
<span class="line">        }
<span class="line">    
<span class="line">    def read_byte(self):
<span class="line">        val = self.bytecode[self.pc]
<span class="line">        self.pc += 1
<span class="line">        return val
<span class="line">    
<span class="line">    def read_dword(self):
<span class="line">        val = int.from_bytes(self.bytecode[self.pc:self.pc+4], 'little')
<span class="line">        self.pc += 4
<span class="line">        return val
<span class="line">    
<span class="line">    def vm_push(self):
<span class="line">        val = self.read_dword()
<span class="line">        print(f"PUSH {hex(val)}")
<span class="line">    
<span class="line">    def vm_add(self):
<span class="line">        print("ADD vreg0, vreg1")
<span class="line">    
<span class="line">    def vm_jne(self):
<span class="line">        offset = self.read_dword()
<span class="line">        print(f"JNE {hex(offset)}")
<span class="line">    
<span class="line">    # ... 实现所有handler
<span class="line">    
<span class="line">    def decompile(self):
<span class="line">        while self.pc &lt; len(self.bytecode):
<span class="line">            opcode = self.read_byte()
<span class="line">            if opcode in self.handlers:
<span class="line">                self.handlers[opcode]()
<span class="line">            else:
<span class="line">                print(f"Unknown opcode: {hex(opcode)}")
<span class="line">                break
<span class="line">
<span class="line"># 使用
<span class="line">dec = VMDecompiler('bytecode.bin')
<span class="line">dec.decompile()</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<h4>5.5 重建原始逻辑（最终目标）</h4>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">输入：反编译的字节码
<span class="line">
<span class="line">PUSH 0x12345678
<span class="line">PUSH [ebp+8]
<span class="line">CALL vm_hash
<span class="line">CMP vreg0, vreg1
<span class="line">JNE fail_label
<span class="line">PUSH 1
<span class="line">RET
<span class="line">
<span class="line">输出：还原的C代码
<span class="line">
<span class="line">int check_serial(char* input) {
<span class="line">    int hashed = vm_hash(input);
<span class="line">    if (hashed == 0x12345678) {
<span class="line">        return 1;
<span class="line">    }
<span class="line">    return 0;
<span class="line">}
<span class="line">
<span class="line">然后可以：
<span class="line">1. 用nop掉验证逻辑
<span class="line">2. 或者写注册机（基于还原的算法）
<span class="line">3. 或者直接patch跳转</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>

<h4>6.1 删除反调试代码（暴力法）</h4>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>

<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">在IDA Pro中搜索并NOP以下代码：
<span class="line">
<span class="line">1. IsDebuggerPresent
<span class="line">   搜索：CALL IsDebuggerPresent
<span class="line">   替换：NOP x 5
<span class="line">
<span class="line">2. 时间检测
<span class="line">   搜索：RDTSC / CPUID
<span class="line">   替换：XOR EAX,EAX (清零结果)
<span class="line">
<span class="line">3. 检查BeingDebugged
<span class="line">   搜索：MOV AL, [FS:0x30] + 0x02
<span class="line">   替换：MOV AL, 0
<span class="line">
<span class="line">4. 异常反调试
<span class="line">   搜索：INT 3 / INT 2D
<span class="line">   替换：NOP</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>

<h4>6.3 测试流程</h4>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">

<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>

<span class="line">   - CFF Explorer 打开，检查PE结构完整性
<span class="line">   - ImportREC 验证导入表
<span class="line">

<span class="line">

<span class="line">   - 与原始程序对比API调用序列
<span class="line">   - 对比关键算法输出</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>

<h2>📌 Part 3: 实战案例分析</h2>
<h3>案例：破解一个简单的VMP2保护程序</h3>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">目标程序：CrackMe_VMP2.exe
<span class="line">保护方式：VMProtect 2.08
<span class="line">目标：绕过序列号验证
<span class="line">
<span class="line">=======================================
<span class="line">步骤记录：
<span class="line">=======================================
<span class="line">
<span class="line">1. 查壳
<span class="line">   ► PEID: VMProtect 2.0x
<span class="line">   ► DIE: VMProtect 2.08
<span class="line">
<span class="line">2. 初步运行
<span class="line">   ► 弹出对话框："Enter Serial"
<span class="line">   ► 输入错误显示："Wrong Serial!"
<span class="line">   ► 推测：验证逻辑被VM保护
<span class="line">
<span class="line">3. x64dbg加载 + ScyllaHide
<span class="line">   ► 所有反调试选项全开
<span class="line">   ► F9运行，程序正常弹窗
<span class="line">   
<span class="line">4. 定位验证函数
<span class="line">   方法：API断点
<span class="line">   ► bp GetDlgItemTextA  // 获取输入的API
<span class="line">   ► F9运行，在输入框输入"test"，点确定
<span class="line">   ► 断下！
<span class="line">
<span class="line">5. 回溯查找验证逻辑
<span class="line">   ► 单步返回(Ctrl+F9)到调用者
<span class="line">   ► 发现代码段：
<span class="line">     CALL GetDlgItemTextA
<span class="line">     LEA EAX, [EBP-0x100]
<span class="line">     PUSH EAX
<span class="line">     CALL 00401234        ← 可疑的验证函数
<span class="line">     TEST EAX, EAX
<span class="line">     JZ   fail_label
<span class="line">   
<span class="line">   ► 00401234 就是验证函数入口
<span class="line">
<span class="line">6. 分析验证函数
<span class="line">   ► 跟入 CALL 00401234
<span class="line">   ► 发现大量混淆代码：
<span class="line">     PUSH ECX
<span class="line">     PUSH EDX
<span class="line">     MOV EAX, [ESP+8]
<span class="line">     JMP 00405678        ← 跳转到VM Entry!
<span class="line">     
<span class="line">7. 识别VM Entry
<span class="line">   地址：00405678
<span class="line">   特征：
<span class="line">     PUSHAD
<span class="line">     PUSHFD
<span class="line">     MOV EBP, ESP
<span class="line">     SUB ESP, 0x200
<span class="line">     MOV ESI, [大量初始化]
<span class="line">     ...
<span class="line">     JMP [EAX*4+0x00406000]  ← Dispatcher!
<span class="line">
<span class="line">8. 简化破解法：爆破跳转
<span class="line">   ► 不去虚拟化了，直接改跳转
<span class="line">   ► 在第5步的代码处：
<span class="line">     TEST EAX, EAX
<span class="line">     JZ   fail_label    ← 改成 JNZ
<span class="line">   
<span class="line">   ► 使用x64dbg修改：
<span class="line">     选中 JZ 指令
<span class="line">     空格 → 编辑
<span class="line">     改成：JNZ fail_label
<span class="line">     右键 → Patch → Patch File
<span class="line">     保存为 CrackMe_VMP2_cracked.exe
<span class="line">
<span class="line">9. 测试
<span class="line">   ► 运行 CrackMe_VMP2_cracked.exe
<span class="line">   ► 输入任意序列号
<span class="line">   ► 成功弹出："Correct!"
<span class="line">
<span class="line">=======================================
<span class="line">总结：
<span class="line">对于简单目标，不需要完全去虚拟化
<span class="line">找到关键跳转直接patch即可
<span class="line">但对于复杂的License系统，可能需要完整分析
<span class="line">=======================================</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<hr>
<h2>📌 Part 4: 进阶技术</h2>
<h3>4.1 自动化去虚拟化工具</h3>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">工具1: VMPAttack
<span class="line">- GitHub开源项目
<span class="line">- 支持部分VMP版本
<span class="line">- 能自动识别Handler
<span class="line">
<span class="line">使用：
<span class="line">python vmpattack.py target.exe --trace --devirt
<span class="line">
<span class="line">工具2: Kryptonite
<span class="line">- IDA Pro插件
<span class="line">- 符号执行 + 污点分析
<span class="line">- 半自动去虚拟化
<span class="line">
<span class="line">工具3: 自己用Unicorn引擎写模拟器
<span class="line">from unicorn import *
<span class="line">from unicorn.x86_const import *
<span class="line">
<span class="line"># 模拟VM执行
<span class="line">uc = Uc(UC_ARCH_X86, UC_MODE_32)
<span class="line">uc.mem_map(0x00400000, 2 * 1024 * 1024)
<span class="line">uc.mem_write(0x00400000, code)
<span class="line">uc.emu_start(0x00401000, 0x00401234)</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<h3>4.2 对抗完整性检查</h3>
<div class="not-prose my-0 flex w-full flex-col overflow-clip border border-border text-text-primary rounded-lg not-prose relative" data-code-block="true" data-sentry-element="CodeBlock" data-sentry-component="CodeBlock" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<div class="border-border flex items-center justify-between border-b px-4 py-2" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockGroup" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx" data-sentry-component="CodeBlockGroup">
<div class="flex items-center gap-2"><span class="text-text-secondary text-sm font-medium">text</span></div>
<button class="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-surface-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 [&amp;_svg]:pointer-events-none [&amp;_svg]:shrink-0 text-sm font-medium text-interactive-active hover:text-interactive-normal active:text-text-tertiary relative rounded-lg p-[6px]" type="button" data-sentry-element="Button" data-sentry-source-file="copy-button.tsx" data-state="closed" data-slot="tooltip-trigger" data-sentry-component="CopyButton"></button></div>
<div class="code-block_container__lbMX4" data-sentry-element="CodeBlockCode" data-sentry-source-file="code-block.tsx">
<pre class="shiki github-light shiki-code-block"><code class="whitespace-pre-wrap break-words"><span class="line">VMP的CRC校验：
<span class="line">1. 在运行时计算代码段的校验和
<span class="line">2. 与内置值比较
<span class="line">3. 不匹配则退出
<span class="line">
<span class="line">对策：
<span class="line">方法1：Hook校验函数
<span class="line">  bp [校验函数地址]
<span class="line">  修改返回值为"正确"
<span class="line">  
<span class="line">方法2：修复校验值
<span class="line">  计算patch后的新CRC
<span class="line">  在内存中搜索旧CRC值
<span class="line">  替换为新值
<span class="line">  
<span class="line">方法3：NOP掉校验代码
<span class="line">  找到CRC计算和比较代码
<span class="line">  全部NOP</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<hr>
<h2>总结</h2>
<p>VMProtect 2 的脱壳是逆向工程中的终极挑战之一：</p>
<p>难度评级：&nbsp;⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (5/5)</p>
<p>时间成本：</p>
<ul>
<li>简单patch：1-3小时</li>
<li>完整dump：1-2天</li>
<li>去虚拟化：1周-数月</li>
</ul>
<p>成功率：</p>
<ul>
<li>基本脱壳：90%</li>
<li>IAT修复：70%</li>
<li>完全去虚拟化：&lt;20%</li>
</ul>
<p>关键建议：</p>
<ol>
<li>从简单目标开始练习</li>
<li>理论+实践结合</li>
<li>善用自动化工具</li>
<li>专注于关键逻辑，不要试图还原全部</li>
<li>考虑替代方案（如内存patch而不是文件patch）</li>
</ol>
<p>最后强调：将知识用于合法的安全研究和学习，尊重软件版权！</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>这是一个非常好的问题，也是无数逆向工程爱好者和安全研究人员梦寐以求的“圣杯”。</p>
<p>答案非常明确且残酷：不存在，也几乎不可能存在一个能够自动化、通用、完美修复VMProtect加密程序的“万能工具”。</p>
<p>下面我将详细解释为什么这在技术上是一个近乎无解的难题，以及为什么你看到的所谓“工具”都只是辅助性的。</p>
<hr>
<h3>第一部分：为什么“万能工具”是一个幻想？</h3>
<p>要理解这一点，我们必须区分**“加壳器 (Packer)”** 和&nbsp;“虚拟化保护器 (Virtualizer)”&nbsp;的根本区别。</p>
<h4>1. 简单的加壳器 (如 UPX)</h4>
<ul>
<li>工作原理：像一个<code class="rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-surface-tertiary font-mono text-[0.9em] text-text-primary font-medium">zip</code>压缩程序。它有一套固定的算法来压缩原始代码，然后在程序入口点放一小段固定的解压代码。</li>
<li>脱壳原理：因为解压算法是固定的，所以可以写一个固定的“解压”工具（脱壳机）。<code class="rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-surface-tertiary font-mono text-[0.9em] text-text-primary font-medium">UPX -d</code>&nbsp;就是这样一个万能脱壳工具，因为它完全了解<code class="rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-surface-tertiary font-mono text-[0.9em] text-text-primary font-medium">UPX</code>的压缩算法。</li>
</ul>
<h4>2. VMProtect (虚拟化保护器)</h4>
<ul>
<li>工作原理：它不是一个<code class="rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-surface-tertiary font-mono text-[0.9em] text-text-primary font-medium">zip</code>程序，而是一个**“语言发明工厂”**。
<ul>
<li>当你用VMProtect保护你的程序时，VMP会为你程序的关键代码发明一种全新的、独一无二的、随机的编程语言（字节码）。</li>
<li>同时，它还会为你**生成一个唯一的解释器（虚拟机VM）**来执行这种新语言。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>核心特性：无限变种 (Infinite Variation)
<ul>
<li>不同的程序，不同的VM：用VMP保护<code class="rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-surface-tertiary font-mono text-[0.9em] text-text-primary font-medium">A.exe</code>和<code class="rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-surface-tertiary font-mono text-[0.9em] text-text-primary font-medium">B.exe</code>，会得到两个完全不同的虚拟机。<code class="rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-surface-tertiary font-mono text-[0.9em] text-text-primary font-medium">A.exe</code>里的VM不认识<code class="rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-surface-tertiary font-mono text-[0.9em] text-text-primary font-medium">B.exe</code>的字节码，反之亦然。</li>
<li>同一程序，每次编译都不同：你用完全相同的设置，两次保护同一个<code class="rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-surface-tertiary font-mono text-[0.9em] text-text-primary font-medium">A.exe</code>，得到的<code class="rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-surface-tertiary font-mono text-[0.9em] text-text-primary font-medium">A_v1.exe</code>和<code class="rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-surface-tertiary font-mono text-[0.9em] text-text-primary font-medium">A_v2.exe</code>，它们内部的虚拟机和字节码也是不一样的。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p>把这个概念具象化：</p>
<blockquote>
<p>想象一下，你想写一个“万能翻译器”。</p>
<ul>
<li>对于<code class="rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-surface-tertiary font-mono text-[0.9em] text-text-primary font-medium">UPX</code>，这很简单，因为你只需要翻译一种公开的语言（比如英语翻译成中文），算法是固定的。</li>
<li>对于<code class="rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-surface-tertiary font-mono text-[0.9em] text-text-primary font-medium">VMProtect</code>，这相当于要求你的“万能翻译器”能够自动翻译地球上从未出现过的、由外星人刚刚随机发明的、且每一个外星人说的都不一样的神秘语言。</li>
</ul>
<p>你会发现，你根本无法制造这样一个“万能翻译器”。你只能逐个去接触每一个外星人，花费大量时间学习并破解他那套独有的语言体系。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h3>第二部分：三大技术壁垒，让“万能工具”无法实现</h3>
<h4>1. 虚拟机架构的无限随机性</h4>
<p>一个自动化工具需要依赖固定的模式（Pattern）来识别和处理代码。但VMP的设计哲学就是消灭一切固定模式。</p>
<p>每次保护，以下所有元素都是随机生成的：</p>
<ul>
<li>虚拟指令集 (Bytecode)：<code class="rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-surface-tertiary font-mono text-[0.9em] text-text-primary font-medium">0x01</code>在A程序里可能是“加法”，在B程序里可能是“跳转”。</li>
<li>虚拟机处理器 (VM Handlers)：执行“加法”的真实x86代码，在A和B程序里完全不同，充满了各种垃圾指令和混淆。</li>
<li>虚拟寄存器：虚拟机的寄存器数量、存储位置（在栈上还是在特定内存区域）都是随机的。</li>
<li>调度器 (Dispatcher)：分发指令的核心逻辑也是千变万化。</li>
</ul>
<p>一个工具无法通过静态分析找到任何可依赖的“签名”或“特征码”来自动化还原这个过程。</p>
<h4>2. 代码变异与深度混淆 (Mutation &amp; Obfuscation)</h4>
<p>即使是虚拟机本身的代码（那些VM Handlers），也是经过VMP深度混淆的。一个简单的&nbsp;<code class="rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-surface-tertiary font-mono text-[0.9em] text-text-primary font-medium">ADD EAX, EBX</code>&nbsp;会被变成几十条甚至上百条等价但难以理解的指令。自动化工具无法分辨哪些是有效代码，哪些是垃圾代码，更无法将其还原成最简形式。</p>
<h4>3. 无处不在的反分析陷阱 (Anti-Analysis Traps)</h4>
<p>VMP会在代码中埋下无数“地雷”，专门用来对抗自动化分析工具。</p>
<ul>
<li>完整性检查 (CRC Check)：自动化工具在分析和修改代码时，会改变文件的校验和。VMP的自校验代码一旦发现文件被修改，就会导致程序崩溃或行为异常。一个“万能工具”除非能智能地定位并修复所有校验点，否则生成的程序就是个废品。</li>
<li>反调试和时序攻击：自动化工具的某些分析技术（如符号执行）可能会被VMP的时钟检测、API行为检测等机制发现，从而触发对抗。</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3>第三部分：那市面上的“VMP工具”是做什么的？</h3>
<p>你可能听过或用过一些名字里带“VMP”的工具，比如<code class="rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-surface-tertiary font-mono text-[0.9em] text-text-primary font-medium">VMPDump</code>、<code class="rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-surface-tertiary font-mono text-[0.9em] text-text-primary font-medium">VMP Unpacker by VT</code>，或者一些开源脚本。它们都不是“万能工具”，而是辅助分析的脚本或小程序，作用非常有限。</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p>自动化Dump工具 (如VMPDump)</p>
<ul>
<li>能做什么：尝试自动完成“寻找OEP”和“内存转储”这两个最最基础的步骤。</li>
<li>不能做什么：完全不能去虚拟化。它Dump出来的文件，关键代码依然是VMP的字节码。</li>
<li>成功率：对非常古老、保护选项弱的VMP版本可能有效。对现代VMP版本基本100%失败。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p>分析辅助脚本 (如IDAPython脚本)</p>
<ul>
<li>能做什么：帮助人类分析师提高效率。例如，一个脚本可以自动地：
<ul>
<li>追踪VM Dispatcher，并列出所有VM Handler的地址。</li>
<li>为每个Handler打上标签，方便你逐个分析。</li>
<li>尝试对字节码进行初步的染色或分组。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>不能做什么：它不能告诉你某个Handler是“加法”还是“减法”。这个最关键的、需要智力判断的工作，仍然需要你手动完成。</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p>学术研究型工具 (基于符号执行、污点分析)</p>
<ul>
<li>能做什么：这是最前沿的尝试。通过模拟执行每一条指令，并追踪数据的流动（污点分析），理论上有可能推断出部分代码的原始逻辑。</li>
<li>不能做什么：
<ul>
<li>极度缓慢：分析一小段VMP代码可能需要几个小时甚至几天。</li>
<li>路径爆炸：遇到复杂的分支，需要探索的路径呈指数级增长，很快就会耗尽所有计算资源。</li>
<li>使用复杂：需要博士级别的专业知识来配置和使用，绝非“一键运行”。</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol><hr>
<h3>结论</h3>
<p>放弃寻找“自动化脱壳VMP的万能工具”的想法。</p>
<p>对抗VMProtect的唯一途径，是将其视为一场人与机器的智力对抗。真正的“工具”是：</p>
<ol>
<li>你的大脑：你的逆向工程知识、逻辑推理能力和分析经验。</li>
<li>强大的调试器和反汇编器：如&nbsp;<code class="rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-surface-tertiary font-mono text-[0.9em] text-text-primary font-medium">x64dbg</code>&nbsp;和&nbsp;<code class="rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-surface-tertiary font-mono text-[0.9em] text-text-primary font-medium">IDA Pro</code>，它们是你的眼睛和手术刀。</li>
<li>无尽的耐心：去虚拟化是一个极其枯燥和漫长的过程，以周或月为单位计算。</li>
</ol>
<p>如果你真的想攻克它，正确的道路是学习扎实的逆向工程基础，而不是在网上寻找那个不存在的“魔法按钮”。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>加密程序的执行流程</p>
<p>解密流程</p>
<p>1.脱壳流程</p>
<p>进入程序的真实入口</p>
<p>dump内存文件</p>
<p>修复pe数据、修复iat</p>
<p>重定位及其他检查<br><br></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1082680/202510/1082680-20251025222730938-2070489118.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>这里壳的作用就是解压和解密代码段和数据段和资源段。入口点变为了虚假的壳入口，而不是代码段的mian函数。</p>
<p>什么是修复</p>
<p>目标是使ida可以正常工作，可以静态分析。<br>保证pe结构关键数据的完整及正确。<br>保证对数据的引用正确，全局变量涉及重定位。<br>保证跳转指令的跳转地址正确，cal、jmp指令涉及重定位。<br>保证api的调用正确，涉及iat的修复</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1082680/202510/1082680-20251025223344044-992466006.png" class="lazyload"></p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>到OEP如何<br>特征法：根据原程序入口特征查找些编译器编译程序的入口特征</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1082680/202510/1082680-20251025224029402-213217759.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;同时我们知道OEP的位置在dump中的ida程序中是没有建立函数识别的，因为没有任何一段函数会引用这段函数，基本可以定位到这个OEP位置</p>
<p>壳分析法：根据壳代码查找这里需要我们熟悉壳代码的流程，知道壳代码将控制权转交给OEP的位置。</p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1082680/202510/1082680-20251025225858753-400521386.png" class="lazyload"></p>

<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1082680/202510/1082680-20251025230111625-336408162.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;vmp检测软件和硬件断点就无法设置oep处的断点</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1082680/202510/1082680-20251025230439949-1631670738.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1082680/202510/1082680-20251025230559577-1581686891.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;1.执行后第一次会自动断点到系统库nt停止，点击执行后第二次第三次，执行是gdi库，第四此就进入到了软件的vmp段，也就是正式进入了壳中。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1082680/202510/1082680-20251026090336153-2042629433.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;2.ctrl+g 输入 vs2017的入口函数特征&nbsp;GetSystemTimeAsFileTime，点击定位后双击进入这个api，</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1082680/202510/1082680-20251026091256738-82165312.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;双击进入这个api，在第二个汇编双击下断点。因为vmp会检测第一句代码。 然后运行</p>
<p>3.继续运行，我们在堆栈返回函数地址，检查段区域，发现在vmp中，说明vmp中也用了这个api，我们跳过这个</p>
<p>4.继续运行，我们在堆栈返回函数地址，检查段区域，发现在text段中，我们右键在反汇编展示这个段汇编定位到返回地址，也就是说调用这个api的入口函数就在这里附近。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1082680/202510/1082680-20251026091620601-1802617182.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;我们在真实入口下断即可，取消api断点，继续执行到这个断点。我们也就完成了vmp段的执行将text段的代码解压也就完成了。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1082680/202510/1082680-20251026091836102-2977164.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;我们查看上一个栈的返回值，我们右键同步反汇编试图发现这里就是真正的oep位置</p>
<p>因此我们清楚了调用流程是</p>
<p>vmp到 txt的oep 再到 txt的api，我们现在在api下。</p>
<p>为了验证猜想，我们下断回退代码。</p>
<p>我们在txt的api下一个返回地址下端，执行，单步执行，发现返回到了oep，同样的操作就返回的了壳子的调用oep的位置。这里就不演示了。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>dump文件整数据保存在文件中。相当于模块内存的将加载到内存中的模块的完一个拷贝。<br>查看dump文件需要16进制编辑器，如winhex</p>
<p>&nbsp;因为加了壳的程序，原代码和数据是以压缩或者加密的形式保存在文件中。只有程序运行到OEP时，内存中才会有完整的原代码和原数据。所以我们需要在OEP处dump模块。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>思考一个问题:是不是OEP以后的位置都可以dump?<br>答案:不是的，需要在处理数据之前，我们还要保证数据段是初始的状态。</p>
<p>&nbsp;当EIP在EP时原代码段是没有数据的，所以这里dump它，是没有意义的。</p>
<p>&nbsp;当EIP在OEP时，其实OEP就在text段说明代码段已经有了数据。</p>
<p>&nbsp;我们已经找到了OEP的位置我们直接到这里，通过比较框架代码，OEP的指令是"call,jmp我们通过栈回溯到OEPMVIO OA/S</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;第二部修复ida</p>
<p>第三步dump内存</p>

<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><a class="relatedlink" href="https://www.52pojie.cn/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">破解</a>VMProtect v.1.6x – 1.7壳<br>1.附加进程<br>2.输入要跟随的表达式：VirtualProtect<br>3.找到Call VirtualProtectEx下端点<br>4.运行，至堆栈窗口显示ReadOnly。（即代码释放完毕）<br>5.打开内存窗口，在第一个代码段设置内存访问断点<br>6.运行后停下来，右键断点–删除内存短点<br>7.找到寄存器的ESP，数据窗口中跟随<br>8.从最低找，找到第一个“返回Kernel32…”，在其上一行设置硬件写入断点（Byte）<br>9.运行，打开内存窗口，第一个代码段设置内存访问断点。<br>10.继续运行，到达OEP。<br>11.可以使用od自带插件，也可用LordPE<a class="relatedlink" href="https://www.52pojie.cn/forum-5-1.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">脱壳</a>，再用ImportREC修复转存。</p>
